RestServiceDefinition.SqlExecute: select user.domainname, user.firstname, user.lastname, user.fullname, user.address1_telephone1, user.address1_city, user.address1_country, datetime(user.createdon) AS createdon, datetime(user.modifiedon) AS modifiedon, user.systemuserid, user.nickname, user.isdisabled, user.internalemailaddress, user.businessunitid_name, user.businessunitid_businessunitid, datetime(COALESCE (substr(logon.earliest_createdon,7,4) || '-' || substr(logon.earliest_createdon,1,2) || '-' || substr(logon.earliest_createdon,4,2) || ' ' || substr(logon.earliest_createdon,12,8), '1953-01-01 00:00:00')) AS lastlogon from usertbl user left join userLogontbl logon on user.systemuserid = logon.user_id
